differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic inflammation from recurrent UTIs, periodontal disease, and obesity‑related low‑grade inflammation most plausibly suppresses erythropoiesis.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Ongoing low‑grade blood loss from gingival disease/tooth infection or occult gastrointestinal bleeding is common in middle‑aged adults with anemia.

differential.name: Vitamin B12 deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Unhealthy alcohol use, possible poor diet, and borderline pre‑diabetes increase risk of nutritional B12/folate deficiency.

differential.name: Anemia secondary to early chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Hypertension and obesity predispose to CKD; even mild renal impairment can reduce erythropoietin production despite normal creatinine.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Persistent anemia in a 49‑year‑old with multiple comorbidities warrants consideration of a primary marrow disorder.
